Card Q&A.a: No, it isn't deleted yet. Once all of the processing for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect is resolved, then all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted at the same time.
Card Q&A.q: I activated "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn" in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, and the DP of my opponent's Digimon became 0. At such times, is that Digimon deleted before the part of the effect after "then"?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn. Then, if it's your turn, 2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into [Silphymon] in the hand.
Inherited Effect: ＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing your top security card, it isn't deleted.)
